facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: injury during transfer operations on ML-3201

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was medical treatment injury, with 1 person injured.

defences.finding: Control PARK_UP_AND_RESTRAINT: the parking, chocking and restraint of equipment had been bypassed, and the learning team review classified this as an organisational factor.
Control POSITIVE_ISOLATION_APPLICATION: the application of positive isolation devices and personal locks was not in place, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control STORED_ENERGY_DISSIPATION: the dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy was in place but did not perform, and the learning team review classified this as a task or environmental condition.
Control ZERO_ENERGY_VERIFICATION: the proving zero energy before intrusive work was not in place, and the learning team review classified this as an individual or team action.

recommendations: Restore the application of positive isolation devices and personal locks on ML-3201 and VT-3201 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in applying and verifying an isolation, specifically proving dead and testing for zero energy. ML-3201 (grinding mills) is in service for two-line ball milling. The task proceeded during transfer operations while the parking, chocking and restraint of equipment had been bypassed. The electrical energy involved is held as HV switchgear, and the recorded presentation was shock, arc flash, unplanned energisation.
response.summary: On 12 November 2022 an incident occurred on ML-3201 and VT-3201 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during transfer operations, releasing electrical energy held as HV switchgear.
